summary.text: Roberto "Bobby" Gonzales is a Democrat who represents District 6 in the New Mexico Senate, covering parts of Los Alamos, Rio Arriba, Santa Fe and Taos counties.
The legislature's member page lists Gonzales as a representative from 1995 to 2019 and a senator since 2019, and as a member of the Senate Finance Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Gonzales's occupation as retired educator.

Between sessions, Gonzales is vice chair of the Investments and Pensions Oversight Committee and a member of the Legislative Finance Committee, the Interim Legislative Ethics Committee and the Mortgage Finance Authority Act Oversight Committee.
